jobs.prompt: Create one polished high-resolution weapon inventory/loadout icon for Fragdachse, a stylized arena shooter. Input 1 is a newly rendered oblique view of the actual in-game Blender model: use it as the authoritative geometry, proportions, colors, components and camera reference. Input 2 shows the existing weapon/upgrade icon art direction only. Transform the model render into clear mildly hand-painted 3D game icon art: broad matte shading, restrained material texture, crisp soft-antialiased contour, stronger midtones and controlled pale edge highlights for legibility at 22–32px. Preserve the real model silhouette and its visible parts. Do not invent a different weapon. One isolated weapon, diagonally butt at bottom-left, barrel at top-right, useful three-quarter view rather than straight top-down. Generous use of square canvas, about 8% clear margin. Transparent background. NO tile, frame, badge, text, character, floor, cast shadow, sparks or scene. No heavy black cartoon outline, photorealism or glossy toy treatment. 1024x1024. NEGEV light machine gun: retain olive-green boxy receiver, chunky side ammunition box and visible short brass belt, dark metal long barrel, top rail and carry handle, folded support legs, sturdy rear stock. Increase broad value separation so the receiver and ammunition box are clearly readable.
